subject: Re: Redwood Demo — Budget timing & Q2 scheduling
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — budget timing

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the invite to demo Redwood. We currently have the session booked for Apr 12 at 10am PT, but I wanted to flag that our executive team is entering a budget freeze for quarter-end and a couple of key stakeholders will be traveling.

TL;DR — can we either:
- move the demo to the week of Apr 26 (after budgets reset), or
- if possible, keep the Apr 12 slot as a short priority walkthrough for our engineering leadership only, and push a full demo to late April?

We want to avoid losing momentum, but procurement likely won't issue any PO until after the FY reset. Appreciate options / what works best on your side.

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Director, Data Platforms
Acme Retail
(Attachment: Q2-priority-stakeholders.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — budget timing

Hi Sophie — totally understand. Thanks for the heads up. We can do either option; two quick proposals from my side:

Option A: Short technical walkthrough (30–40m) on Apr 12 with your engineering leads. We hold the full product + business demo until week of Apr 26.
Option B: Move the full demo to Apr 26/27 and we’ll provide a reserved POC sandbox and a priority onboarding session when you’re ready.

Can you confirm which you prefer? Jordan — looping you in in case you want the short walkthrough now.

I’m attaching an updated MAP and our pricing term sheet so you have them for procurement.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
(Attachment: Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — budget timing (internal)

Hey team — quick note on options:

- We can offer the short 30–40m technical walkthrough on Apr 12 for engineering only (no pricing discussion). That keeps momentum.
- If they move to Apr 26, recommend we offer a short trial window (30 days of sandbox access) or a one-week priority sandbox to keep them engaged while procurement finishes.

Question: are we comfortable offering any credit/discount if they ask to push? If not, we can lean on the priority sandbox + MAP to preserve deal economics.

Happy to sign off on holding a priority slot for them if Marissa confirms.

—Nikhil
Head of Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — budget timing (internal)

Nikhil / Marissa — I think we should avoid a discount at this stage. Offering a 1-week priority sandbox + a reserved demo slot in late April is low-cost and keeps momentum. If procurement pushes the PO past May, we can revisit credits tied to contract signing dates.

Please do the short walkthrough on Apr 12 if Sophie wants it; otherwise confirm new demo date. I can approve the priority slot. If they explicitly ask for any financial concession, route to finance for manager approval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — Budget timing & confirmed next steps

Hi Sophie / Jordan — thanks for the context. Per internal alignment, here’s what we can do: 

- Move the full demo to Mon Apr 26 at 10am PT (we can also do Apr 27 if that’s better).
- In the meantime we’ll provide a 1-week priority sandbox (pre-configured) for your engineers to test prefix caching and latency on a sample workload — available immediately once you confirm.
- We will keep the Apr 12 slot open as a short 30–40m engineering-only walkthrough if your team prefers that timeline.

Attachments: Updated MAP and calendar invite for Apr 26. Pricing term sheet attached for procurement visibility.

Please confirm which path you prefer and I’ll send the calendar invite and sandbox access details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: calendar-invite.ics)

On Apr 05, 2027 Laura Bennett wrote:
> Nikhil / Marissa — I think we should avoid a discount at this stage. Offering a 1-week priority sandbox + a reserved demo slot in late April is low-cost and keeps momentum.
>

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme-retail.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: 2027-04-10T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo on Apr 12 — Budget timing & confirmed next steps

Marissa — thanks for the options and for being flexible. We’ll take Option B and move the full demo to Apr 26 at 10am PT. The engineering team would also like the 1-week priority sandbox — please send access details.

Procurement is looped and will follow up on PO timing; they expect to start the process in mid-May after our FY reset. No request for pricing concessions at this time.

Please go ahead and send the calendar invite and sandbox instructions. Looking forward to the demo.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Director, Data Platforms
Acme Retail
(Attachment: stakeholder-list.pdf)
